item.title: Course in Wildlife Trade & Forensics for Revenue Officers
item.description: The Wildlife Institute of India offers this specialized training program focused on wildlife trade and forensic techniques for revenue and enforcement officers. Participants will gain practical knowledge on identifying illegal wildlife products and understanding the legal frameworks governing trade. This initiative aims to strengthen the enforcement capacity of government officials working in border and customs security across India.
item.author: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) (Remote (India))

item.title: Program Manager (Water Supply)
item.description: The Program Manager oversees the installation and maintenance of community-based water filtration systems across India. You will manage project deployments in schools and rural settings while ensuring long-term infrastructure sustainability through regular monitoring. This role requires significant field travel to project sites to provide technical training and support to local beneficiaries, directly contributing to safe water access for underserved populations.
item.author: Planet Water Foundation (Pune)

item.title: Head/Director – National Conservation Programme
item.description: The Director of the National Conservation Programme will lead WWF-India's initiatives on raptor conservation and the Conservation Catalyst Programme. Based at the New Delhi secretariat, this senior role involves managing field projects, coordinating with state branch offices, and providing technical mentorship to grassroots partners. You will drive strategic vision while ensuring scientific excellence and financial compliance across diverse conservation portfolios.
item.author: WWF-India (Delhi)

item.title: Director – Brahmaputra Programme
item.description: The Director will lead WWF-India's conservation efforts across the Brahmaputra Basin, focusing on freshwater and terrestrial habitat restoration. You will manage a multidisciplinary team of over 30 specialists to implement strategies for climate resilience, sustainable agriculture, and community-led stewardship. This position requires high-level engagement with government agencies, donors, and local communities to drive institutional growth and long-term environmental impact.
item.author: WWF-India (Tezpur)

item.title: Consultant for Satluj River Basin Assessment
item.description: The Nature Conservancy is seeking a consultant to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the Satluj River Basin in Punjab. This project focuses on integrating agroforestry practices, freshwater conservation strategies, and ecological restoration initiatives. The selected agency will provide actionable data to guide sustainable land and water management interventions across the river basin to improve regional biodiversity and agricultural resilience.
item.author: The Nature Conservancy (TNC) (Remote (India))

item.title: Assistant Manager - Horticulture
item.description: The Assistant Manager will lead horticulture and afforestation initiatives to enhance green cover within mining operations. Based in Ahmedabad, the role involves managing nursery development, biodiversity conservation projects, and regulatory compliance with forest departments. You will coordinate with cross-functional teams and external vendors to meet plantation targets while ensuring strict adherence to environmental safety standards and ministry reporting requirements.
item.author: Adani Natural Resources (Ahmedabad)

item.title: Project Lead
item.description: You will lead an integrated rural livelihoods programme in Sundargarh, focusing on natural resource management and climate-resilient agriculture for tribal households. The role involves managing project teams, overseeing watershed and irrigation interventions, and ensuring donor compliance. You will also build convergence with district administration to support community-led institutions and sustainable farming practices.
item.author: ACCESS Development Services (Sundargarh)

item.title: Coordinator - Tea
item.description: This role manages the development of sustainable tea farming practices for smallholder growers in Assam. You will coordinate with research institutes and certification bodies to improve food safety and wildlife-friendly agricultural standards. The position requires frequent travel across tea-growing districts to facilitate farmer field schools and strengthen supply chain linkages for certified smallholder produce.
item.author: WWF-India (Assam)
